settings.title: WhatsApp via webhook
settings.description: Send WhatsApp notifications through a Zapier / Make / n8n hook — no vendor account needed.

whatsapp_webhook.targetUrlHelp: HTTPS URL that receives each notification as signed JSON (Zapier, Make, n8n…).
whatsapp_webhook.secretShownOnce: Copy this secret now — it is shown only once. Use it to verify the X-DentalPin-Signature header in your automation.
whatsapp_webhook.testHelp: Sends a signed test payload to your hook so you can wire up the automation.
